See: RColorBrewer::display.brewer.() vector colors interpolated hm_color_values Either NULL vector values used interpolation colors. Passed values ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn() hm_color_breaks Breaks heatmap colors. Passed breaks ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn() hm_color_limits vector length = 2 limits heatmap color scale. Passed limits ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(). scale TRUE, data scaled (z-score) center TRUE, data centered cluster_rows TRUE, rows clustered stats::hclust() cluster_cols TRUE, columns clustered stats::hclust() dist_method Distance method passed stats::dist(). Also supports correlation distance (1-cor()), dist_method passed method stats::cor clustering_method Clustering method passed method stats::hclust() raster TRUE, ggplot2::geom_raster() used heatmap tiles instead ggplot2::geom_tile(). recommended function large tables. rows_title title row variables. column_title title column variable. colors_title title color legend. fontsize Base fontsize plot, used theme. Must one "euclidean", "maximum", "manhattan", "canberra", "binary", "minkowski", "pearson", "spearman" dist_p power Minkowski distance, chosen dist_method "minkowski" hclust_method agglomeration method. method supported hclust, one :  "ward.D", "ward.D2", "single", "complete", "average" (= UPGMA), "mcquitty" (= WPGMA), "median" (= WPGMC) "centroid" (= UPGMC). cor_use using correlation distance, chooses method computing covariances presence missing values.
